name: Jellycap
description: Plays a short recap before an episode (Android TV friendly).
overview: Builds a recap video from previous episodes (and from the already-watched part of a resumed episode) with ffmpeg, then tells the Android TV client to play it before the episode.

versions.changelog: 1.3.0.0: Recap text cards now also work with the JellyTvOverlay app (JellyXR TV is still supported this release). 1.2.0.0: New setting *Recap when resuming an episode* (also per show): previous episodes + this episode so far (default), previous episodes only, or this episode so far only. Text and Both recaps of the watched part quote the episode subtitles (dialogue cards per moment, spoiler free). 1.1.1.0: Fix recaps failing on Jellyfin 10.11 and newer (TypeLoadException for Jellyfin.Data.Enums.SortOrder). Episodes are now ordered by the plugin instead of the library query.

Episodes are now ordered by the plugin instead of the library query.

1.1.0.0: Text cards on the JellyXR TV app overlay. When the JellyXR TV app (1.1.0 or newer) runs on the box, Text recaps pause the episode and show the cards over the player instead of playing a video, and Both recaps play the clips with the cards on top. Setting: Show text cards with the JellyXR TV app (default on).
1.0.5.0: Plugin icon. Includes 1.0.4.0: fix episode lookup failing on Jellyfin 10.11.
1.0.4.0: Fix episode lookup failing on Jellyfin 10.11 (MissingMethodException in GetItemList).

1.0.2.0: Detailed logging (recaps played, built, skipped and why; ffmpeg timeouts; cleanup results). Set Jellyfin.Plugin to Debug in logging.json for skip reasons.

name: JellyXR
description: X-Ray style cast cards on pause (Android TV friendly).
overview: Scans videos once with on-server face recognition to learn which cast members appear when. Pause on Android TV and JellyXR sends text cards with the actors on screen (this scene) or the whole episode cast.

versions.changelog: 1.8.1.0: Pause cards show the episode and, with Xrayarr, the current scene ("S01E03 · Scene 12 of 85 · 12:30–14:05"; setting ShowSceneInfo). Repository CHANGELOG.md lists the commits behind every release. 1.8.0.0: Actor and character names in a chosen language (TMDB, English fallback); Xrayarr people are matched to the Jellyfin cast by TMDB person id; optional X-RAY badge on posters; X-Ray chip when a title with X-Ray data starts playing. 1.7.0.0: Cast panel works with the JellyTvOverlay app (JellyXR TV is still supported this release); new actor detail with bio and titles in your library. 1.6.0.0: X-Ray items are no longer added to an "X-Ray" collection; the collection earlier versions created is deleted on the first marker sync (the next playback or the "Mark items with X-Ray data" task). The "X-Ray" tag and the optional genre stay.

The "X-Ray" tag and the optional genre stay.

1.7.0.0: Cast panel works with the JellyTvOverlay app (JellyXR TV is still supported this release); new actor detail with bio and titles in your library. 1.6.0.0: X-Ray items are no longer added to an "X-Ray" collection; the collection earlier versions created is deleted on the first marker sync (the next playback or the "Mark items with X-Ray data" task). The "X-Ray" tag and the optional genre stay.

1.6.0.0: X-Ray items are no longer added to an "X-Ray" collection; the collection earlier versions created is deleted on the first marker sync (the next playback or the "Mark items with X-Ray data" task). The "X-Ray" tag and the optional genre stay.

1.5.0.0: X-Ray markers. Movies and episodes with X-Ray data get an "X-Ray" tag and join an "X-Ray" collection, so the Android TV app (which can't show plugin UI) shows which items have X-Ray: Collections -> X-Ray, or filter by tag. Optional: also add "X-Ray" as a genre so it shows on the TV movie page. New scheduled task "Mark items with X-Ray data" (daily 05:00). Settings: Mark items, Also add as genre, Marker name.

1.4.0.0: Support for the JellyXR TV companion app for Android TV: with the app installed on the box, pausing shows a panel with cast portraits over the Jellyfin player instead of 2-line toasts (new setting "JellyXR TV app: on pause show the portraits panel", on by default). Devices without the app still get text messages.

1.3.0.0: Web client: pausing shows a panel with cast portraits (on screen first, then the rest of the cast), until playback resumes. Android TV: pause messages are 2-line toasts lasting 3.5 s, so the cast is packed into numbered messages (1/3, 2/3...), each repeated to stay up for the configured seconds; Current scope lists the rest of the cast after the people on screen; Max actors 0 = all (new default). New icon layout.

1.2.0.0: Cast appearance timeline. Cards show time on screen and when the actor is next seen. New timeline viewer (with Scan / Rescan) in the plugin settings. Movie and episode pages of the web client get an X-Ray section with a bar per actor. Plugin icon.
1.1.5.0: Fix scan failing on Jellyfin 10.11 (MissingMethodException in GetPeople/GetItemList). Cards are now sent even when the client (e.g. Android TV) reports no remote control.

1.1.4.0: Fix plugin shown as Malfunctioned: Jellyfin tried to load the native onnxruntime.dll as a .NET assembly. The package now lists its assemblies in meta.json. Includes 1.1.3.0: own log file jellyxr.log.
1.1.3.0: Own log file jellyxr.log in the Jellyfin log folder (Debug and up, rolls at 10 MB). Server log unchanged.
1.1.2.0: Detailed logging (pauses, cards shown, data source used, scans, model load; Debug level explains why nothing was shown).
1.1.1.0: Test Xrayarr connection button on the settings page (checks URL and API key before saving).
1.1.0.0: Xrayarr integration (scene data from an Xrayarr server, as the only source or as primary/fallback to the local face scan).
Initial release

name: JellySubSync
description: Shift subtitles earlier or later from the TV remote (JellyXR TV app).
overview: Pause twice quickly in Jellyfin on Android TV and the JellyXR TV app shows a subtitle sync box. JellySubSync writes a shifted copy of the subtitle track (the original stays untouched), remembers the offset per item, and the app restarts playback on the synced track.

versions.changelog: 1.1.0.0: The sync box now works with the JellyTvOverlay app (JellyXR TV is still supported this release). 1.0.2.0: Fix HTTP 500 on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x (user and version APIs changed); jellysubsync.log is written from startup and logs every error. 1.0.1.0: Plugin logo. 1.0.0.0: First release. Shifts text subtitles (SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, and embedded text tracks) for the JellyXR TV app sync box (app 1.2.0 or newer). Opt-in: turn it on for all titles, or only for chosen libraries, shows and movies.

name: JellyTvOverlay
description: Generic TV overlay host: other plugins show layouts on the JellyTvOverlay Android TV app.
overview: Host for the JellyTvOverlay renderer app. Plugins send layout v1 JSON; the host routes triggers and actions.
